purpose: Country evidence inventory to support a later, separately validated agricultural enterprise-budget and calculator profile. This file is not calculator input and must not activate the country.

observations.finding: Identified by FAO as the country's main food crop, cultivated throughout the year in northern and southern regions depending on rainy seasons.
Harvest completed in January 2026; output estimated near average after generally beneficial weather.
Planting completed in March for harvest in July; FAO reported favourable weather and adequate, well-distributed precipitation since December 2025.

observations.item: Cereal import share of total cereal utilization

caveats: Cereal import forecast is not domestic crop production or a farm price.
The near-average maize assessment is qualitative and does not provide a national yield in tonnes per hectare.
Cassava is a key crop but the brief does not give a 2026 cassava yield or farmgate price.

evidence_sections.topic: official national agricultural statistics and census
evidence_sections.source_name: Institut National de la Statistique du Congo (INS-Congo), agricultural statistics portal
caveats: The INS portal and its catalogue confirm that national reports exist; listing a report is not the same as extracting or validating its tables.
Detailed crop-by-crop area, output, yield, region and farm-size observations still need to be transcribed from the source reports and reconciled.

evidence_sections.source_name: Africa API presentation of FAOSTAT data
evidence_sections.publication_or_reference_date: FAOSTAT series through 2024; API page retrieved 2026-10-03
caveats: This is a secondary presentation of FAOSTAT and must be checked against the original FAOSTAT bulk data before any calculator use.
Production series are national aggregates and do not identify farm-level yields, production systems, harvest losses or marketable output.
Do not treat these values as current-season forecasts.

evidence_sections.topic: consumer price monitoring and market prices
evidence_sections.publication_or_reference_date: Portal accessed 2026-11-01; latest displayed bulletin M8-2026; key city indices dated February 2026
caveats: These are broad consumer price indices, not commodity-specific farmgate prices or producer prices.
Index points cannot be converted into XAF/kg without the underlying item-level price observations and base-period prices.

evidence_sections.source_name: Soko by Yelessa, agricultural market price platform

observations.finding: Platform states coverage of major markets in Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire, including Total Bacongo, Moungali, Ouenzé, Mfilou, Grand Marché, Tie-Tie and Mvou-Mvou.
Includes cassava, yam, sweet potato, taro, tomato, onion, chilli, aubergine, plantain, okra, fresh and smoked fish, beef, chicken, palm oil, rice and maize.
Platform states that weekly average prices by market and product are collected and verified by field agents.

caveats: The public landing page describes the service but does not expose a downloadable, independently verifiable time series in the material reviewed.
Prices described are market/wholesale or retail-side market observations, not farmgate prices; obtain commodity, grade, unit, market, date, sample count and trader/producer level before use.
Do not enter platform prices into the calculator until sample data and methodology are independently checked.

evidence_sections.topic: agricultural structure, import dependence and priority value chains
evidence_sections.source_name: API-CONGO, Agriculture sector overview and PND 2022–2026 project pipeline
evidence_sections.publication_or_reference_date: Web page accessed 2026-11-01; underlying indicators largely 2017–2020 and investment plan 2022–2026

observations.finding: Agency states that less than 10 percent of cultivable land is developed.

observations.period: recent years as described on page; exact years not specified

observations.finding: Government investment pipeline identifies cassava, banana, soybean, potato, cocoa, oil palm, rubber, cashew, coffee, horticulture, cattle, small ruminants, poultry, aquaculture and wholesale market infrastructure.

caveats: These are investment-promotion statements and older macro context, not a substitute for current production or cost observations.
The reported cultivable-land potential and food-import estimate have broad definitions and require reconciliation with national accounts and customs data.

evidence_sections.topic: food market size and import dependence
evidence_sections.source_name: U.S. Department of Commerce, Trade.gov, Republic of the Congo Agricultural Sector

observations.item: Food imports share of domestic food consumption

observations.finding: Identified as a crop with potential for human food and poultry/livestock feed.

caveats: The food-import share is an older broad estimate and differs in scope from FAO's 2026 estimate that cereals account for about 90 percent of cereal utilization.
The USD market-size table is a sector-level estimate and not a crop price, producer price or farm revenue benchmark.

evidence_sections.topic: macro context relevant to cost and price assumptions
evidence_sections.source_name: IMF, Republic of Congo: Post-Financing Assessment
caveats: Macroeconomic inflation is not a substitute for agricultural input price inflation or farmgate commodity prices.

evidence_sections.topic: official INS agricultural report catalogue and extraction priorities
evidence_sections.source_name: Institut National de la Statistique du Congo (INS-Congo), Recensement Général de l'Agriculture catalogue
evidence_sections.publication_or_reference_date: Catalogue accessed 2026-11-02; reports listed for reference years 2020–2024

observations.finding: The official statistics portal explicitly lists these reports as downloadable national agricultural statistics and directs further data requests to INS-Congo.

caveats: A catalogue entry confirms a report exists, not the numerical contents of its tables.
The 2024 results are explicitly preliminary and must remain labelled preliminary until final tables or revisions are found.
The 2023 cultivated-area and production report is a high-priority source for matching area and production before calculating yields.

evidence_sections.topic: administrative geography and regional calculator mapping
evidence_sections.source_name: ASARECA country profile and conflicting newer secondary administrative-division report
caveats: The available sources conflict: ASARECA describes 12 departments, while a newer secondary account says 15 departments were created by laws published in October 2024.
The INS agricultural catalogue page reviewed does not itself provide a current administrative code list or boundary crosswalk.
Do not add a Republic of the Congo region selector until the legal instrument, official department names/codes and effective date are verified from a primary government source.
Do not map historical agricultural observations to the alleged new departments without a documented boundary crosswalk.

calculator_data_gaps: Extract and reconcile crop area, production, yields, production system and regional breakdowns from the INS 2024 preliminary agricultural census, 2023 crop survey and 2022/2021 reports.
Verify the 2024 FAOSTAT cassava, maize, rice, cocoa, coffee and livestock observations against original FAOSTAT data.
Collect dated farmgate prices in XAF/kg or XAF/standard unit by crop, grade, location, season and transaction level; do not substitute consumer or wholesale prices.
Obtain current seed/planting-material, fertiliser, crop-protection, labour, land preparation, irrigation, energy, packaging and transport quotations.
Build crop-specific enterprise budgets with explicit input quantities, labour days, cycle length, yields, losses, by-products and sensitivity ranges.
Identify regional production zones and realistic crop calendars, particularly for cassava, plantain, maize, rice and horticultural crops.
Confirm livestock, poultry, aquaculture and fisheries unit economics separately; do not infer enterprise costs from national production totals.
Resolve the reported 2024 administrative reorganisation using primary legal texts and an official INS/Ministry department nomenclature before adding any regional selector.
Download and extract the INS 2024 preliminary results and 2023 cultivated-area/production report; retain preliminary status and reconcile overlapping years.

activation_blockers: No validated crop-specific current farmgate price series
No validated crop-specific input quotations or enterprise budgets
Official INS report tables not yet fully extracted and reconciled
Secondary FAOSTAT transcription requires original-source verification
Current administrative department list and historical-to-current geographic crosswalk not verified from primary legal sources

safeguards: This record is research evidence only and must not be consumed as live calculator data.
Do not activate Republic of the Congo or alter calculator formulas based on this file.
Do not treat market/consumer prices, import values, policy targets or potential yields as farmgate prices or realized farm yields.
